question: Which of the following Vedas mentions dance (Nrti) and danseuse (Nrtu)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rigveda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rigveda is considered the oldest among the four Vedas and is composed of hymns praising various deities.
 
• It mentions dance (Nrti) and danseuse (Nrtu) as part of its descriptions of cultural practices and rituals.
 
• Dance and music were integral aspects of Vedic rituals and cultural expressions during the Rigvedic period.
 
• The Rigveda primarily focuses on spiritual hymns but also provides insights into social and artistic practices.
 
• References to Nrti (dance) and Nrtu (danseuse) highlight the significance of performing arts in ancient Vedic society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vedas:**

 
 
• The Vedas are the most ancient religious texts of India and are considered the foundation of Hindu philosophy.
 
• There are four Vedas: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, and Atharvaveda.
 
• Each Veda is divided into four parts: Samhitas (hymns), Brahmanas (rituals), Aranyakas (theology), and Upanishads (philosophy).
 
 
 
• **Rigveda:**
 
 
• The Rigveda consists of 1,028 hymns organized into ten books (mandalas).
 
• It is primarily composed in Sanskrit and is one of the oldest known texts in human history.
 
• The hymns are dedicated to various deities such as Agni (fire), Indra (rain and thunder), and Varuna (cosmic order).
 
 
 
• **Performing Arts in Vedic Era:**
 
 
• Dance, music, and drama were significant elements of Vedic rituals and ceremonies.
 
• Nrti (dance) and Nrtu (danseuse) symbolize the cultural and artistic expressions during the Rigvedic period.
 
• Music was often used in the chanting of Vedic hymns to invoke deities.
 
 
 
• **Samaveda and Music:**
 
 
• Although the Rigveda mentions dance, the Samaveda is more closely associated with music and chanting.
 
• The Samaveda focuses on melodies and chants that accompany rituals and ceremonies.
